title: Portability Onboard Decision Tree & Evidence Slate
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, actionable playbook for hires that need a high-touch portability/onboarding path (eg. cross-pool transfers, late-stage contractors converting, and urgent backfills). The artifact combines a hiring-decision tree, interview evidence rubric, and a pragmatic 72hr + 14d activation checklist so managers can move from offer to impact quickly while preserving signal for calibration and later HR/PE checks.

Scope and usage notes:
- Scope: ICs (IC-2 to Staff) converting or joining internal teams where continuity or domain knowledge is critical.
- Use this doc in offer-to-day-14 window; copy evidence into candidate record (Confluence) and link to Jira onboarding ticket.
- Keep items short and time-boxed. This is intended for rapid decisions and early mitigation (not a full performance plan).

High-level decision tree (one-page mental model):
1) Acceptance and access gating (0–24h):
   - Ensure offer accepted and signatories completed.
   - Confirm L1 access: Google, HR systems, Slack, Zoom, GitHub (read).
   - If access fails >24h -> trigger "access escalation" (SRE/tooling owner).

2) Role alignment check (0–48h):
   - Hiring manager runs 15m alignment with hire: top 3 deliverables for first 30 days.
   - If hire cannot name top 3, mark "needs role-clarity" and schedule alignment workshop with manager + partner.

3) Skills & safety triage (0–72h):
   - Quick skills probe by peer: 30m session with a subject-matter peer using two focused prompts (see rubric below).
   - If serious gaps in critical skill (security, infra, compliance) -> put temporary guardrails (pairing, reduced privileges) and escalate to people-ops for remediation plan.

Interview evidence rubric (picks the minimum signals we accept to greenlight independent work):
- Signal buckets (score each 0/1/2):
  1. Core role skills (technical or product): 0 = no signal, 1 = partial, 2 = strong/proven.
  2. System ownership & communication: 0 = unclear, 1 = adequate, 2 = proactive/clear.
  3. Security / compliance awareness (if applicable): 0/1/2.
  4. On-call/readiness (if role requires): 0/1/2.
  5. Cultural fit & collaboration: 0/1/2.
- Passing threshold: total >=7 (out of 10) is green for independent work; 5–6 requires a 14d buddy plan and limited scope; <=4 requires staged onboarding with explicit success criteria.
- Evidence artifacts to attach: recorded notes, PRs or past work links, pair-session outcomes, test tasks (if used).

Pre-built probe scripts (30m peer probe) — pick two per probe session:
- Infra/Platform candidate: "Explain a recent performance/regression issue you debugged end-to-end. What data/metrics did you look at first and why?" + follow-up: "Where would you add an alert if this happened again?"
- Product/Platform PM or Solutions: "Walk me through a time you had to trade off latency vs correctness in a shipped feature. What metrics moved?"
- SRE/Security: "Describe an incident you escalated. Who did you notify, and what safeguards did you implement afterwards?"
- Behavioral: "Tell me about a time you had to onboard someone new; how did you prioritize knowledge transfer?"

Immediate 72hr activation checklist (owner tags in parentheses):
- Day 0–1 (HR / Manager):
  - Confirm signed offer and payroll / contractor status. (HR)
  - Create Jira onboarding ticket with deliverables and link this doc. (Manager)
  - Hardware ordered or cloud access provisioned; temporary hardware fallback if delayed. (IT)
  - 30m intro sync scheduled with manager + 30m with peer-buddy. (Manager)
  - Slack intro post and buddy assignment. (Manager)
- Day 1–3 (Manager / Buddy / Eng Lead):
  - Buddy pairs for walkthrough of the codebase or runbook (2hrs total). (Buddy)
  - First small-to-medium scoped task assigned (<=3 days) with clear acceptance criteria in Jira. (Manager)
  - First 30m skills probe session logged and scored with rubric above. (Peer)
  - Security/privacy checklist completed if role handles PII. (Security Partner)
  - Access re-check: token, secrets manager, monitoring dashboards. (Infra)

14-day activation & risk-mitigation slate (Manager primary):
- Week 1 goals (0–7 days):
  - Task A: Complete a small change end-to-end (code, test, deploy or equivalent for non-eng).
  - Shadow: Attend two operational runbooks.
  - Feedback: Manager does first 1:1 and gives explicit feedback on initial deliverable.
- Week 2 goals (8–14 days):
  - Task B: Ownership of a minor service area or feature flag.
  - Autonomy check: Peer rate (0–5) on independence for the assigned area.
  - Calibration: People-ops pulls evidence and the manager completes "14d activation check" form (link to Confluence).

Mitigation actions for common failure modes:
- Access or infra onboarding delays >72h: temporary pairing, read-only access, and escalation to infra on SLA.
- Role mismatch (hire cannot perform core skill): implement 14–30 day remedial plan with weekly milestones; do not expand privileges beyond minimal safe set.
- Behavioral or collaboration concerns: 2-week coaching loop with evidence notes; if no improvement, escalate to HR for PIP conversation.

Evidence ledger template (copy into candidate Confluence page):
- Candidate name: 
- Role: 
- Offer accepted date: 
- Onboarding owner (manager): 
- Buddy: 
- Probe sessions (date + brief notes + rubric scores): 
- First deliverable link(s): 
- Security/compliance attestation: 
- Manager 14d activation check result: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL (brief rationale)
- Next steps / remedial plan (if applic): 

Unresolved questions / TODOs (for People Ops review):
- Should we centralize the 14d activation form as a Google Form to auto-populate records? (cost/benefit)
- Do we want automated Slack reminders for buddy pairing at 24h and 72h?
- Clarify who signs off on reduced-privileges window >30 days (security vs manager).

Quick quick notes (notes-to-self style — preserve):
- Keep the probe short and pragmatic; the goal is actionable signal not an exhaustive interview.
- For internal transfers, prefer evidence from prior team (PRs, retros) over new timed tests.
- If hire is converting from contractor, capture previous reviewer names.
- We should A/B test threshold =7 vs =8 for independent access on infra roles — track outcomes.

Appendix: links & templates
- 14d activation check (template): CONFLUENCE-PORT-14D-TEMPLATE
- Minimal security checklist: CONFLUENCE-SEC-ONBOARD-BASICS
- Recording storage location: google-drive://people-ops/onboarding-evidence/

End.
